method_name: forward stepwise selection (FSS), PRSice-2, elastic net (EN)
method_params:
LD r2 < 0.9, 
FSS p  <0.05,
PRSice-2 with optimally selected p-value threshold between 5x10-8 and 0.5 (increments of 5x10-5) that offered the maximum r2 value when regressing each BC phenotype on the selected PRS, 
EN optimal lambda by minimazing prediction error using 10-fold cross-validation
